0.7.1 is a drop-in patch for 0.7.0: format epoch 3 is unchanged, with no storage, snapshot or Raft protocol change. Upgrade from 0.7.0 in place with an ordinary rolling restart (`helm upgrade`). No fresh install or data move is needed.

- **Upgrade the chart and the image together.** The 0.7.1 chart passes the gateway the new `--upstream-tcp-user-timeout` flag, which a 0.7.0 gateway refuses at startup. A values file that pins `global.image.tag` or `gateway.image.tag` must move it to 0.7.1 with the chart.
- **Gateway failover.** `ursulagw` gives up on a connection to a vanished node after 5 seconds of unacknowledged data (`--upstream-tcp-user-timeout`, Helm `gateway.upstreamTcpUserTimeoutSeconds`), and it skips an upstream that failed at the transport for 10 to 60 seconds instead of picking it again at random ([#495](https://github.com/tonbo-io/ursula/issues/495), [#454](https://github.com/tonbo-io/ursula/issues/454)).
- **SQLite VFS.** A commit that a layer in front of the stream refuses with `402` fails alone, without poisoning the file, and the next commit succeeds once the layer accepts writes again. `attach(file, url, { readOnly: true })` reads a database without claiming its stream. Owners upgrade one at a time: the 0.7.0 and 0.7.1 extensions take over each other's streams.
- **Recovery.** A node that lost its WAL run state starts its recovery epoch above the epochs its cores verified, and a failed snapshot pointer write no longer lets the node delete the snapshot object that the pointer names.
- **Release images** carry build provenance and an SPDX SBOM as GitHub artifact attestations instead of attestation manifests on GHCR. Verify with `gh attestation verify oci://ghcr.io/tonbo-io/ursula:0.7.1 --repo tonbo-io/ursula`.
- **Rust library APIs changed** in `ursula-control`, `ursula-raft`, `ursula-runtime`, `ursula-proto` and `ursula-gateway`, with no wire or on-disk change.

Known issues: [#411](https://github.com/tonbo-io/ursula/issues/411) and [#507](https://github.com/tonbo-io/ursula/issues/507). Every change is listed in the [0.7.1 release notes](https://ursula.tonbo.io/docs/release-notes#071).
